action: Black. Soft alarm shows 7:00 on the nightstand. Hero asleep, a blank notebook and pen visible on the desk across the room.
sound: Soft rounded alarm chime x2, room tone

action: Hero sits up, looks across the room at the desk. Resolve in the half-lidded eyes.
Hero sits at the desk, opens the blank notebook, holds the pen over page one. HUD appears: DAY 1.
Villain leans in the doorway behind, relaxed and friendly, one hand raised like a friend. Dim ember eyes.
camera: Hold, villain slowly rises into frame
sound: Low felt note, drone fades in

action: Hero glances back, closes the notebook, slaps a sticky note TOMORROW on the cover.
Close-up: the sticky note moves onto the wall calendar. HUD DAY 1 -> DAY 2.
DAY 2. Hero on couch with phone; villain sits beside him, arm around his shoulders.
transition_in: match cut on the sticky note

action: DAY 3. Hero comes home with a shiny new notebook and planner for a 'fresh start', lines them up neatly. The old notebook sits buried under the stickies.
DAY 5. Hero tidies the desk, lines up pens (productive procrastination). Notebook untouched.
DAY 9. Laptop open on 'how to be productive' videos. Hero watches, chin on hand.
DAY 11. Hero peels the TOMORROW stickies and writes MONDAY on a new one, sticks it on the wall calendar.
DAY 14. Hero stares at the ceiling, TOMORROW stickies piling up on the wall calendar.
camera: Slow tilt up to the wall

action: DAY 23. Sticky pile covers the notebook. Villain is bigger, arm around the hero. Hero's eyes sunken.
DAY 40. Hero asleep on the couch, phone dropped. Villain tucks a blanket over him.
DAY 60. Hero walks along the empty road toward a small signpost reading TOMORROW far at the vanishing point.
Seasons pass on the road: rain, then falling leaves, then snow (particle overlays). HUD DAY 100 -> 150 -> 200. The TOMORROW signpost stays just as far away. Hero keeps walking, collar up.
sound: Wind and rain bed under sparse piano, soft footsteps

action: Hero keeps walking; the signpost never gets closer (it recedes). HUD ticks fast: 61 ... 120 ... 200. Villain walks beside him.
DAY 365. Hero stops, slouches. Signpost still far away. Music drops to silence.
Close on hero's tired face. Villain behind him, huge, hand on his shoulder.
text: V: Come back when you're ready.

action: 1.5s of nothing. Hero looks down. Camera tilts to the road: weathered white paint under his feet reads TODAY.
camera: Tilt down to the ground text
sound: Single soft piano note after the silence

action: Hero kneels and touches the painted TODAY letters. Faded paint dust on his fingertips.
camera: Low close-up on his hand and the letters

action: Extreme close-up of the hero's eyes opening fully.

Rewind: earlier lines return and get crossed out, replaced by white truth. 'Tomorrow.' -> 'Today.'  'Just five more minutes.' -> 'That is how years vanish.'  'You are not ready.' -> 'Nobody is.'  'Rest first.' -> 'Start small.'  'Come back when you are ready.' -> 'Ready is a decision.'
camera: Fast reverse of earlier clips under the text
sound: Tape-rewind-like soft whir (not harsh), piano arpeggio builds

action: Fade up on the desk at dawn. Hero sets a 2:00 timer on the phone.
sound: Soft click, piano lifts to major

action: Hero writes the first words. Timer counts down. Villain by the window shrinks smaller.
Timer rings softly. Hero keeps writing. Villain is now a small shadow by the window.
DAY 1 starts again: DAY 2, 3, 4... Notebook pages stack up, sunlight moves across the desk.
DAY 30. The notebook is thick now. Hero leans back, looks out the window at the sunrise and exhales. The tiny villain on the sill turns away.
Proof visual: on the wall calendar the TOMORROW stickies peel away one by one and checkmarks take their place. Hold 3s.
sound: Soft peel + tick per mark, warm chord

action: Hero walks the dawn street, notebook under his arm. The TOMORROW signpost is now behind them, small and fading. Tiny villain follows far back.
Hero stops on the painted TODAY, small smile, looks ahead.
Hero walks away from camera toward the sun-warmed horizon.
Dark card. Title PROCRASTINATION with a hand-drawn red underline. Line 1: Tomorrow never comes. Line 2 (brick red): You're standing on today.
text: PROCRASTINATION / Tomorrow never comes. / You're standing on today.
